_note: Street, ownership, events, critiques, gaps and conflicts for Aditya Birla Capital as of 30-Sep-2026. Broker notes dated after 30-Sep-2026 (Emkay 1-Nov, Jefferies ~14-Oct) are excluded.

street._method: Every broker that discloses a method values ABCL on a sum of the parts (SOTP) on Mar-28E: the NBFC at ~2.0-2.3x book, the HFC at 1.8-2.2x book, the AMC stake at 26-28x earnings, ABSLI at 1.3-1.5x embedded value and ABHI at ~1.0x GWP or deal value. Emkay deducts a 20% holding discount on the subsidiaries; Motilal Oswal shows none.

brokers.thesis: Steady quarter, but NBFC margins flat when expansion was expected; consolidated PAT CAGR ~28% FY26-28E; NBFC margin recovery is the key monitorable

brokers.multiple: Standalone 2.3x adj. book; ABSLI 1.5x IEV; ABHFL 1.8x adj. book; AMC/ABHI/discount n.d.

Standalone Q1 PAT ~7% above estimate; strong ABSLI margin; FY27 growth outlook raised

brokers.multiple: 2.2x Mar-28E standalone P/B implied at target

consensus.note: No clean dated consensus snapshot for 30-Sep-2026. StockAnalysis (S&P Global) at the 30-Jul-2026 close: 14 analysts, Strong Buy, average target ₹434.71 (range ₹365-495), from a search snippet; Bloomberg via askfuzz.ai (31-Jul/3-Aug-2026): 15 analysts, all Buy.

estimates._note: Street consolidated estimates we can source (Motilal Oswal, 2-Aug-2026): PAT post minority ₹5,010 cr / ₹6,390 cr, EPS ₹18.5 / ₹23.6, ROE 13.1% / 14.2% for FY27E / FY28E; consolidated P/B 2.6x / 2.3x at ₹404.

ownership.src: BSE shareholding pattern via Screener.in; q1ppt p2
ownership.note: Promoter holding rose from 68.51% (Mar-26) to 68.81% (Jun-26) after the June preferential allotment (Grasim 8.09 cr and Suryaja 0.56 cr of the 11.24 cr new shares; IFC the rest, ~0.9% of the enlarged capital by our arithmetic). Foreign investors fell from 10.9% (Mar-24) to 5.2% (Dec-25) and recovered to 7.9%; domestic institutions rose from 7.6% to 13.4% over the same period.

events.title: Board approves ₹4,000 cr preferential issue at ₹356.02
events.detail: Promoters ₹3,080 cr, IFC ₹920 cr; EGM approval 12-Jun-2026; allotted in June.

events.title: Q1FY27 results
events.detail: Consolidated PAT ₹1,175 cr (+40%); NBFC AUM +28%, PAT +35%; HFC AUM +50%; ABSLI VNB margin 15.1% (7.5%); ABHI first-quarter profit under IFRS; gold-loan entry announced.

events.title: Stock hits a record ₹430.70 after results
events.detail: Brokers raised targets (ICICI Securities ₹470, BofA ₹445, Motilal Oswal ₹480).

events.title: IRDAI consultation paper on insurance distribution
events.detail: Proposes ~2-5% caps on commission for loan-linked insurance sold by lenders; comments to 25-Oct-2026. Hits NBFC fee income from insurance attachment; ABSLI's group credit-life business (51% growth in Q1, a third sourced from the group's NBFC and HFC) could see lower acquisition costs but slower sales.

events.title: September sell-off
events.detail: Nifty and Sensex down ~5% for the month by 28-Sep on foreign selling, Brent ~$106 and US 10-year yields at 5.2%; a majority of economists expected a 25bp repo hike. ABCL closed at ₹380.60 on 30-Sep, ~12% below its August high.

holdcoHistory._why: Inputs for ABCL's discount to look-through value at each quarter-end since Mar-2022 (first March after the AMC listed in Oct-2021). March points are interpolated linearly in between. NBFC book = Aditya Birla Finance's equity (FY22-FY24) and, after the merger, ABCL standalone net worth less investments in group companies at cost (FY25 ₹25,194 − 6,622; FY26 ₹28,701 − 8,991; Jun-26 ₹33,700 − 8,991). Health = sales GWP for the fiscal year (TTM ₹8,027 cr at Jun-26 = FY26 + Q1FY27 − Q1FY26). Shares in crore from paid-up capital (Mar points; the FY24 raise landed in Q2FY24, the FY27 one on 23-Jun-2026).
holdcoHistory.src: ABFL equity: q4fy23ppt p27, q4fy24ppt p26; standalone net worth: q4ppt p8, q1ppt p8; investments at cost: ar26 related-party note; HFC: q4fy23ppt p28, q4fy24ppt, q4fy25ppt, q4ppt p31, q1ppt p32; EV: q4fy23ppt p54, q4fy24ppt p43, q4ppt p47; GWP: q4fy23ppt, q4fy24ppt p63, q4fy25ppt p64, q1ppt p65; AMC stake: amcofs and ar26 AOC-1 (12,96,43,873 shares = 44.89% → 28.88 cr shares); FY21 EV and GWP (₹1,301 cr): q4fy21ppt p45, p57 (only used for Mar-22, before the FY22 EV/GWP were published in May-2022)

regulatory.upperLayer: ABCL is an NBFC-ICC in the RBI's upper layer (bank-like governance; CRAR ≥15%, Tier 1 ≥10%). Investments in subsidiaries are deducted from Tier 1, which is why the NBFC needs the parent's equity even though the insurers hold their own capital.
regulatory.insurance: IRDAI's 23-Sep-2026 consultation (see events); ABSLI moved to new surrender-value rules in FY25; ABHI adopted IFRS from 1-Apr-2026.

critiques: A holding company with partners everywhere: Sun Life owns 49% of ABSLI and co-promotes the AMC, Momentum and ADIA own 54% of ABHI, Advent 14% of ABHFL. Cash flows up to ABCL mainly as the AMC dividend (₹311 cr in FY26); insurers need capital, not pay dividends.

Dilution: equity raised in FY24 (preferential to promoters) and again in Jun-2026 (₹4,000 cr at ₹356.02, below the ₹380.60 price on 30-Sep but a premium to the day before the board meeting). Share count up from 241.6 cr (Mar-22) to ~273.7 cr.

NBFC margins have not expanded: NIM incl. fees 6.22% (FY25) → 6.06% (FY26) → 6.07% (Q1FY27) as the book tilted to secured MSME and corporate loans; the promised lift depends on personal and consumer loans rising back to 18-19% of AUM.
Group drags: ABHI ran a 105-106% combined ratio in FY26-Q1FY27; the ABCD digital platform lost ₹264 cr in FY26; 'others' cost ₹298 cr of segment PBT in FY26.
AMC: equity market share has slipped (HDFC Securities); mutual-fund QAAUM grew only 6% YoY in Q1FY27 against a faster industry.
Insurance-linked fee income: NBFC fee income rose 60% YoY in Q1FY27 on processing fees and insurance attachment, exactly the income IRDAI's September proposal targets.
gaps: Named non-promoter holders above 1% (Jun-2026): not sourced; IFC's exact allotment (~2.58 cr shares) is inferred from the board approval, not a filing we read.
ABHI statutory net worth at Mar-2026: not found (AOC-1 shows only ABCL's equity-method carrying value ₹3,268 cr); we value ABHI on gross written premium instead.
ABHFL AUM for FY24-FY25 and PAT for FY24: not extracted; net worth is available for every year.
ABSLI and ABHI do not publish embedded value / appraisal values beyond ABSLI's IEV; Sun Life's 2016 purchase (₹7,235 cr for 100%) is too old to use.
Quarterly split of NBFC fee income between insurance commission and processing fees: not disclosed; the IRDAI impact on fees is our estimate.
Jefferies' latest target before 30-Sep-2026 (₹425?) seen only in blocked aggregator snippets: left out of the street table.
Five-year median P/EV for listed life insurers: no broker states one; we compute it from EV disclosures and Screener prices (trailing EV, latest March).
conflicts: Kotak: Investing.com still lists Kotak Institutional Equities at ₹410 (5-May-2026); Kotak Neo's research article (4-Aug-2026) shows fair value ₹460. We show ₹460 and flag it.

Consolidated EPS FY26: Screener shows ₹14.75 (profit incl. minority ÷ shares); the annual report's basic EPS is ₹14.41 (owners' profit ₹3,764 cr). We use the reported ₹14.41 in our consolidated comparisons.
ABHI GWP: 'sales GWP' without 1/n (₹7,292 cr FY26) vs GWP with 1/n (₹6,855 cr); we use sales GWP, the basis of the Q1FY27 deck.
Motilal Oswal's SOTP per-share column implies ~260 cr shares, below the ~273 cr after the June allotment.
